info.title: OpenFinder Local HTTP Plugin Protocol
info.description: Canonical loopback-only HTTP/JSON and Server-Sent Events contract for OpenFinder plugins. The protocol version is 1.

get.description: Unauthenticated calls return public availability fields. A valid bearer token may add plugin, runtime, and environment-check details.

post.summary: Create or idempotently retrieve a plugin job
post.description: The PluginInput taskID is the sole idempotency key. A semantically identical replay returns the existing job; conflicting input for that taskID is rejected.

get.summary: Replay and follow a job's Server-Sent Events
Read the single terminal result event

BearerAuth.description: Local plugin token. It is transport state and never appears in PluginInput or logs.

ProtocolHeader.name: OpenFinder-Plugin-Protocol
ProtocolHeader.description: Requested protocol version. Only version 1 is supported.

TaskID.name: taskID
TaskID.description: OpenFinder task UUID and job idempotency key.

LastEventID.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventID.description: Greatest event ID already processed. Zero is valid before the first event.

JobSnapshotExisting.description: Semantically identical idempotent replay; existing job returned without re-enqueueing.

CancellationAccepted.description: Cancellation accepted; an active job is cancelling or a queued job has cancelled.

CancellationObserved.description: Idempotent repeated cancellation or a job already in a terminal state.

EventStreamOK.description: Retained events after the cursor, followed by live events.

schema.description: UTF-8 SSE frames. Each event data value validates as SSEEvent.

ResultOK.description: The job's one terminal result event.

InvalidRequest.description: Malformed JSON or a PluginInput that does not validate.

InvalidTaskID.description: The path taskID is not a UUID.

InvalidLastEventID.description: Last-Event-ID is malformed, negative, or ahead of the job's greatest event ID.

example.message: Last-Event-ID is ahead of the job event sequence.

Unauthorized.description: Bearer token is absent or invalid.

example.message: A valid local plugin token is required.

TaskConflict.description: The taskID exists with semantically different PluginInput.

example.message: taskID already belongs to different input.

RequestTooLarge.description: The request body exceeds the advertised limit.

example.message: The request body exceeds the configured limit.

UnsupportedProtocol.description: The requested plugin protocol version is unsupported.

example.message: Only OpenFinder plugin protocol 1 is supported.

QueueFull.description: The bounded job queue has no capacity.

example.message: The local plugin queue is full.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The plugin cannot accept work because a required local dependency is unavailable.

example.message: A required analyzer dependency is unavailable.

JobNotFound.description: The job is unknown, expired, or invalidated by restart.

EventHistoryExpired.description: Replay cannot continue without skipping discarded events.

example.message: Requested event history is no longer retained.

JobNotTerminal.description: The result is unavailable until the job reaches one terminal state.

example.message: The job has not reached a terminal state.

InternalError.description: Unexpected server failure before a response or stream is committed.

example.message: The local plugin could not complete the request.
